fields.value: Interpose. triggered defence; spends its next attack action; once per fight. Trigger: A close ally is hit by a melee attack while the guard is standing. Range: close. story.label: Opening
story.value: Rain darkens the piazza stones. Messengers cross the bridges while watchmen check the gates.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: The request
story.value: Elten brings the work to the party through Meridia City Watch. Elten is tracking an outlaw, monster or rival who has fled into the wilds.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Archive of the Quiet Beast. Rescue Bram, Human Monk, held at the disputed flooded hold. Secure Radiant, polished pearl (40 gp), in the salvaged sealed coffer of the old claim. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The job offers a way to settle a dispute over access. Taking the reward without completing the objectives leaves the route and its claim unresolved.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

monster.name: Guard
traits: Interpose. triggered defence; spends its next attack action; once per fight. Trigger: A close ally is hit by a melee attack while the guard is standing. Range: close. The guard immediately shifts to an unoccupied reachable position close to that ally and takes the triggering attack's damage and riders instead. The shift cannot pass through an enemy. It forfeits its next attack action, but may still move on that turn. It must be conscious and able to move; it cannot intercept area damage. Telegraph: It keeps its weapon across the approach to the person it protects. Behaviour: Use for the protected person named before the encounter; if none is named, protect the close ally with the lowest current HP, choosing randomly on ties.
vulnerabilities: Force: Takes twice the damage from force damage.
